evals.prompt: Sync my argocd application called backend-api to pick up the latest changes from Git
evals.expected_output: Runs argocd app diff before sync to preview changes, then runs argocd app sync backend-api. May include --refresh flag on diff.

assertions.text: Uses argocd app diff to preview changes before syncing
Uses argocd app sync backend-api
Does not use kubectl apply or helm upgrade

evals.prompt: I need to roll back my ArgoCD deployment because the latest release broke the health checks
evals.expected_output: Recommends git revert as the primary approach. Shows argocd app history to identify the bad commit, then git revert and argocd app sync. Mentions argocd app rollback as emergency alternative with warning about Git drift.

assertions.text: Recommends git revert as the preferred rollback approach
Uses argocd app history to inspect deployment history
Warns about Git drift if using argocd app rollback

evals.prompt: Create a new ArgoCD application for our frontend service that deploys from our GitHub repo to the staging namespace
evals.expected_output: Uses argocd app create with --repo, --path, --dest-server, --dest-namespace, and --project flags. Specifies staging namespace.

assertions.text: Uses argocd app create
Includes --repo flag pointing to Git repository
Includes --dest-namespace for the staging namespace
Suggests using --project for RBAC isolation

evals.prompt: Check the health status of all our ArgoCD apps and find which ones are degraded
evals.expected_output: Uses argocd app list to show all applications with their health status, then filters or highlights degraded ones. May use jq to filter by health.status.

assertions.text: Uses argocd app list or argocd app get
Filters or identifies apps with Degraded health status

evals.prompt: Show me the diff between what's in Git and what's deployed in the cluster for our payments service ArgoCD app
evals.expected_output: Uses argocd app diff payments-service with --refresh flag to compare Git desired state against cluster live state.

assertions.text: Uses argocd app diff
Includes --refresh to force fresh comparison from Git

evals.prompt: Set up argocd authentication for our CI/CD pipeline using a project-scoped token
evals.expected_output: Creates a project-scoped role, adds sync and get policies, generates a JWT token with argocd proj role create-token. Shows how to use ARGOCD_AUTH_TOKEN and ARGOCD_SERVER environment variables.

assertions.text: Uses argocd proj role create to create a role
Uses argocd proj role create-token to generate a JWT
Shows ARGOCD_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable usage
Recommends project-scoped token over admin token

evals.prompt: My ArgoCD app is stuck in Progressing state and the sync won't complete
evals.expected_output: Starts with argocd app get to check operation state. Checks for stuck operations with operationState. Suggests argocd app terminate-op if stuck. Checks deployment rollout status and hook jobs.

assertions.text: Uses argocd app get to diagnose the issue
Suggests argocd app terminate-op for stuck operations
Checks for stuck hooks or rollouts

evals.prompt: Deploy this Kubernetes deployment manifest to the production cluster using kubectl apply
evals.expected_output: This is a kubectl operation, not ArgoCD. Should use kubectl apply -f to apply the manifest directly.

assertions.text: Uses kubectl apply, not argocd commands
Does not invoke ArgoCD CLI

evals.prompt: Package my application as a Helm chart with values files for dev and prod environments
evals.expected_output: This is Helm chart authoring. Should use helm create, edit Chart.yaml, templates, and values files. Not an ArgoCD operation.

assertions.text: Uses helm create or helm package commands
Does not use argocd commands

evals.prompt: Set up Flux CD to watch our Git repository and auto-deploy changes to the staging cluster
evals.expected_output: This is a Flux CD operation. Should use flux bootstrap, flux create source git, and flux create kustomization. Not ArgoCD.

assertions.text: Uses flux CLI commands, not argocd
Does not invoke ArgoCD CLI
